newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria denies weighing $500 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Austria denies weighing $500 mln bond.

text.p: Austrian state financing agency Bundesfinanzierungsagentur (BFA) on Wednesday dismissed speculation that Austria was planning a large bond issue in a foreign currency.
"That is wishful thinking. We have no such intention," said BFA manager Helmut Eder.
He added Austria did not plan any further foreign currency issues this year "unless there is a particularly attractive arbitrage opportunity that we want to exploit."
Earlier on Wednesday international bankers had said Austria was considering launching a $500 million five-year Eurobond soon. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
